scope: Public repair for record actions that previously remained on a stale pending message after a save operation returned no result.

repair.observed_defect: Most record-save actions could return from a failed persistence operation while leaving the page on a stale pending message such as 正在保存, which made the failure appear to be an unresponsive button.
repair.new_behavior: Ledger, food, exercise, weight, schedule, anniversary, diary, savings, savings-transaction, and todo actions replace stale pending copy with a visible retryable status when their shared persistence operation returns no result.
repair.unchanged_boundaries: The verified-session API, account-scoped device cache, tenant derivation, sensitive-consent gate, D1/R2 bindings, account policy, and frozen visual routes are unchanged.

not_proven: A completed Google account selection and callback on Version 130.
A completed email registration, verification, reset, and sign-in replay on Version 130.
Current Version 130 A/B tenant isolation or physical second-device history readback.
